beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Start with the composite paper and keep its evidential content separate from its pedigree.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Follow the incentive chapters before turning to the proposed institutions of correction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The conclusion asks for a better use of trust, not its disappearance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Borrowed Credibility gives readers a vocabulary for locating specific failures in scientific confidence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also provides proposals that deserve pilots, criticism, and revision rather than automatic adoption.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to ask how expertise can remain useful while evidence stays capable of changing minds.
